summary: The step pictures carry ghosts the painter never paints: sky-blue blotches with dark spots sit in the cow's area from step 1 to step 10, gold appears in the silver-cloud step, and flat hard-edged cut-out shapes stay in the hillside from step 7 until the cow covers them. Several steps add colors their one paint can't make (dark bushes in step 7, bright gold blades in 10, dark shadows and a pink nose in 13, gray-cream horn shine in 16), and the grass steps put the grass top about 2 in too high.
